false_starts_and_limits: MSYS path conversion initially broke WSL script path; fixed by MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1.
UEFI VGA ROM lookup failed before explicit VGA romfile was supplied; not a media defect.
BIOS USB early harness selected USB media instead of preselected 1024MiB target; disposable overlays only were altered. Corrected BIOS run is bios-usb-ponpno2o.
Initial BIOS resource parsing returned false despite authenticated prompt; independent disk-only confirmation then verified both fields.
UEFI original ISO fails loading /linux.x86_64 after rEFInd selection; candidate changes only the catalog count field.
First count-zero trial did not install; repeat w780nsls populated target and authenticated disk-only with resource proof.
Attempt to overwrite already read-only catalog candidate raised PermissionError; changed harness to verify/reuse immutable candidate.
UEFI USB qhsm894p reached kernel/menu but wrote USB overlay, not target. No UEFI USB target-install success claimed from that run.
Automated OCR flags can misidentify firmware resolution 1024 as disk size and leave stale menu/confirmation text visible; successful gates require populated target plus detached authenticated login.
Screenshot hashes retained; raw screenshots/console/identifiers not exported. Scratch may be removed; sanitized records here are durable.
No full repository test suite run by this runtime subagent. No licensing, physical USB, bare-metal, owner VM, networking, SFP, Secure Boot or non-x86 runtime tested.
Production fix owned by separate implementer/coordinator; two-byte candidate is not itself final source-built production artifact.

evidence_validation.initial_validation_false_start: Validation mistakenly expected 16 result.json trials; actual records are 15 trials plus one selection-only record. Corrected count and gate checks passed.
